name: multi-layer design
definition_zh: 把参数或设计任务按层次分组进行分析与设计的方法。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道系统参数优化中，用于沿轮轨界面两侧组织参数配对，逐层分析匹配效果，为车辆与轨道参数的协调设计提供依据。

complete_examples.text: The numerical examples illustrate that the multi-layer design and weight combination method is simple and effective, which provides a new technology approach for parameters optimization of vehicle-track coupling system.

Based on the optimization of low dynamics of wheel-rail interface interaction, this method developed a multi-layer design methodology, where the vehicle-track system parameters were divided into different groups each with two parameters, to investigate the dynamics behavior of system components under different parameters matching.
